title: Product Baseline: New Focus Flow (v3.0.0)
summary: This release established the modern CogniFocus baseline with a rebuilt flow, refreshed onboarding, and upgraded Shield experience.
highlights: Redesigned app flow around the new Focus tab
improvements: Added appearance settings including dark mode
bodyMarkdown:
## Highlights

- Redesigned app flow around the new Focus tab
- Refreshed onboarding
- Improved Focus Shield flow

## Improvements

- Added appearance settings including dark mode
- Added new timer clock styles

## Why this matters

Product Baseline: New Focus Flow (v3.0.0) is one of those tidy-up releases that does not need a parade, but it still helps the Shield feel less fussy. Small fixes matter here because CogniFocus is supposed to get out of your way fast. Tap in, start the thing, dodge the scroll spiral, continue your tiny heroic quest. That is the whole deal.

- Redesigned app flow around the new Focus tab gets a little more room to breathe.
- Refreshed onboarding gets a little more room to breathe.
- Improved Focus Shield flow gets a little more room to breathe.
- Added appearance settings including dark mode gets a little more room to breathe.

So yes, this is a smaller note. The point is still real: fewer weird little moments, clearer feedback, and less friction between you and the session you meant to start. The Goblin may still be dramatic about it, obviously, but the app should feel calmer where it counts.
